description: For B2B outreach: checks that a Brazilian mobile number found for a decision maker (in a sheet or a search) really belongs to that person, before a campaign writes to it, from the owner's name and e-mails the registry has for it. One number per call. Meant only for a business contact the user is already prospecting, not for identifying a private individual. Charged 10 credits only when a name comes back. It does not return a document number.
name: phone_owner
title: Confirmar o dono do número
